candidate.title: The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character
candidate.text: The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character. Validation can be currently bypassed configuring `upgradeCompatibility` to v1.15 or earlier, but will be strictly enforced starting from Cilium v1.17.

evidence.excerpt:
* The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case
  alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character.
  Validation can be currently bypassed configuring `upgradeCompatibility` to
  v1.15 or earlier, but will be strictly enforced starting from Cilium v1.17.
